scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && node scripts/check-type-escapes.ts && node scripts/check-hosts.ts && node scripts/check-agent-docs.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run test && pnpm run test:scripts
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run test:unit && pnpm run test:scripts
scripts.coverage: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run coverage
scripts.pkg:check: pnpm run build && pnpm -r run pkg:check && knip
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node scripts/check-agent-docs.ts --write-versions && pnpm install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts
